text:
alex_park: Heads-up — vendor just flagged a ~3 week slip on MI300 shipments. Need to decide marketplace/SI announcement scope. @anna_amd can you confirm? :thinking:
anna_amd: Confirmed. Internal ETA moved to May 26. We'll push an official note tomorrow. Sorry for the churn.
maya_singh: OK — pragmatic Q: what breaks if MI300 isn't in wave1? SI images, perf docs, SKU tags?
sujan_r: Biggest operational risk is SI training/bench images expecting ROCm baseline. Quick checklist: 1) marketplace SKU tags 2) SI test matrix 3) announcement copy fallback
rachael_brown: Can we still announce H100/H200/B200 and mark MI300 as "coming soon"? Legal ok with that phrasing?
sam_legal: Yes. Avoid implying parity or fixed ship dates. Use "planned" or "coming soon" and coordinate embargos with partners.
alex_park: Proposed plan: delay MI300 mention, proceed with H100/H200/B200 announce on 2026-06-10. Add MI300 as "coming soon / Q3 TBA". Owners: SI cert = sujan_r, marketplace tags = maya_singh, comms copy = rachael_brown, vendor handshake = alex_park.
john_nvidia: We'll reconfirm H200 firmware/tag by Wed and can supply a H200 test image for SI teams.
anna_amd: We'll try to pull forward a small validation batch for partners if SW signoff occurs. Otherwise Q3 still likely.
maya_singh: For SI images we need kernel + driver baseline. Current recipe we expect to ship with (if MI300 present):
```
kernel: 6.5.12
rocm: 6.0.1
driver: amdgpu-pro-24.80
image-tag: registry.redwood.ai/si/mi300-rc:2026-05
```
sujan_r: If MI300 is delayed we'll run perf validations on B200 and H200 and map differences to an MI300 expected profile for docs + signals. Also update CI matrix to skip mi300 jobs until we get test hardware.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace announce (H100/H200/B200) — 2026-06-10" — https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/marketplace-announce-2026-06-10
alex_park: Timeline summary: today draft copy, Wed vendor confirms firmware/ETA, Fri SKU freeze, 2026-06-08 internal dry run, 2026-06-10 announce. Contingency: if MI300 land before 6/08 we add it to the wave; otherwise it ships as a Q3 follow-up.
rachael_brown: I'll prepare copy with a single switchable stanza so we can toggle MI300 language last-minute. Canary plan: two-region rollout with canary in us-west1.
maya_singh: Eng action: create a fallback matrix repo + CI labels. Repo stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-fallbacks (please don't hard-depend on it yet)
sujan_r: :thumbsup: I'll stub the test matrix and skip rules this afternoon.
alex_park: Thanks everyone — @anna_amd please ping this thread when you have the official note and ETA. Closing for now, will re-open if vendor updates change dates. :white_check_mark:
